ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the upper left of the figure there is a mountain peak symbol, with an elevation of 573m marked beside it; the middle is a village, and the river flows from near the mountain peak in the upper left toward the village area in the middle, then flows toward the southeast. The waterfall symbol is located on the southeast side of the village, on the river, and the black dot of the viewing platform is located near the downstream side of the waterfall. The contour lines in the figure are relatively sparse, and the question stem gives the contour interval as 100m. Then reason: according to the positions of the contour lines, the upper end of the waterfall is roughly slightly below the 300m contour line, and can be estimated to be about 288—290m. The waterfall drop is 60m, so the elevation of the water surface of the pool below the waterfall is about 228—230m. The viewing platform is 5m above the water surface of this pool, so the elevation of the viewing platform is about 233—235m. The mountain peak elevation is 573m, and the elevation difference from the viewing platform is about 573-233≈340m. Therefore the most likely elevation difference is 340m.

method.method_draft: 先读图：左上方山峰符号旁标注高程为573m；河流从山峰附近流向村庄东南侧，瀑布符号位于村庄东南、观景台黑点的上游附近；结合等高线形态和100m等高距，可判读瀑布上端约在300m等高线稍低处，约288—290m。再读题干：瀑布落差60m，观景台比瀑布下方水潭水面高5m。因此水潭水面约为(288—290)-60≈228—230m，观景台约为233—235m。山峰与观景台高差约为573-233≈340m，故取340m。
